title: Evaporated Si Protective Coatings for FIB-Prepared High-Quality S/TEM Lamellas
content: Today, the dual focused ion beam/scanning electron microscope (FIB/SEM) is arguably the most important, effective, and ubiquitous instrument for the fast and efficient preparation of specimens (lamellas) from bulk samples for scanning/transmission electron microscopy (S/TEM) analysis [1-4].
